tagline: Spot it. Mark it. Call it.
brief: A bingo game a group of Aussie mates plays while one of them screen-shares dashcam videos on Discord. The logo has to work as a browser-tab icon, beside the name in the site's dark top bar, and as a Discord avatar, in one colour too, because every player picks their own square colour.
criteria: Success: says dashcam and bingo without a lens, a ball or a red record dot; recognisable at 16 px; works on the site's charcoal and in one colour.

concepts.name: Viewfinder
concepts.idea: The dashcam's frame locks onto your winning line.
rationale: Two frame corners say camera; a 3 × 3 card with a marked diagonal says bingo, with no lens, ball or record dot
Bingo Green is the site's own default square colour, so the logo and the game share one signal colour
A simplified cut (heavier corners, no dots) keeps it crisp from 32 px down to a 16 px browser tab
The name is set in Plus Jakarta Sans ExtraBold, the site's own font, outlined so it looks the same everywhere

recommendation: Use the horizontal lockup in the site's top bar, the symbol tile for the browser tab and Discord, and the stacked version for anything square like stickers and shirts.
next_steps: Add the favicon and web icons to the site (files in kit/web)
Swap the plain-text title in the top bar for the logo
Use the Discord icon for your server or bot
